editorial: Imagine a universe where your boldest wish summons stardust. Wish turns this fantasy into a dialogue between a street‑smart teen and an untamed star, refusing to map the galaxy in clichés. The star’s vibrant energy—painted in pixel‑perfect frames—densifies the film’s visual craft into an engaging centerpiece that feels alive. You’ll resonate if you enjoy watching a light‑hearted adventure that whispers courage into family screen time. Pacing lags in the middle act, but the core moments shine.
targetAudience: Ideal for families looking for light‑hearted adventures blended with emotional depth in a fantastical setting.
